name: Convex-Geometry Ideal Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite nonempty set family, up to signed-coordinate equivalence and suppression of constants.
statement: Lower ideals of convex geometries, upper ideals of learning spaces, and one-marker conditionings of learning spaces define the same graph class.
proof: Set complementation exchanges a convex geometry with a learning space and exchanges its lower ideals with upper ideals. For an upper ideal $\mathcal C$ of a learning space $\mathcal L$, the marked family $(\mathcal L\times\{0\})\cup(\mathcal C\times\{1\})$ is accessible and union closed, and its $1$-section is $\mathcal C$. Conversely, the source theorem reconstructs a largest ambient learning space for every inherited pc-minor satisfying the equivalent source condition.
